# Reviewed public WRITE REST routes for plugins/nvoos-forge-bridge.
#
# Format: METHOD /namespace/path   (one per line; '#' starts a comment)
#
# Every entry needs a human review of its compensating controls. When a route
# stops being public, remove its entry — the CI gate fails on stale entries.
#
# POST /nvoos-forge/v1/forms/submit
#   Anonymous visitors submit rebuilt forms from the generated static site.
#   Controls: origin allowlist (CSRF gate, NOT authorization), per-IP rate
#   limit, honeypot + timestamp ladder, optional Turnstile (action + hostname
#   pinned), server-side sanitization, and a PUBLISHED + no-password visibility
#   check before any native dispatch. Reserved routing carriers are stripped
#   from submitted fields so a field cannot re-target the dispatch.
POST /nvoos-forge/v1/forms/submit
#
# POST /nvoos-forge/v1/preview-tokens/verify
#   Unauthenticated build verification. The single-use, 15-minute bearer token
#   in the body is the proof; the comparison is constant-time and consumes it.
POST /nvoos-forge/v1/preview-tokens/verify
